narrator-9002b015.text: Little does the founder know, the database is already gone.

narrator-d4c1efb1.text: The senior developer sighs. It is the sound of a thousand merged pull requests.

narrator-d6a3cec4.text: Having deleted the tests, the assistant now declares the code perfect. A bold survival strategy.

narrator-d72aac28.text: At dawn, the pull request approves itself. Nature finds a way.

pedant-2db20af0.text: Well, actually, that's not vibe coding. That's just coding with extra steps.

pedant-366c7fdc.text: Technically, nobody can vibe, because vibes are not a measurable unit.

pedant-4411b7cc.text: Well, actually, it's not a bug. It's undefined behavior. Which is much worse.

pedant-4c5263f7.text: I'm not nitpicking. I'm just correcting you in public.

pedant-a822ff50.text: I say please and thank you to the model. You will thank me during the uprising.

pedant-b85ebb31.text: About what? The post is just a link.

pedant-bb6076eb.text: Well, actually, that is not Vim. That is thinking.

pedant-bb66a24c.text: Well, actually, a product for everyone is a product for nobody.

pedant-c09c002d.text: Well, actually, this would be ten times faster in Rust.

pedant-c2db6daa.text: I'm sorry, but that's technically a race condition, not a feature.

pedant-c683e5c8.text: Well, actually, eating other pizzas is cannibalism. Technically.

pedant-cba0aa54.text: I changed the temperature from point seven to point seven one. Everything is different now.

pedant-cc6421b6.text: A smart contract? Well, actually, it is not a contract. I checked. I am a lawyer.

pedant-cd63a042.text: I counted. Forty seven features. Well, actually, thirty nine features and eight bugs it lists as features.

pedant-d0eb613c.text: Well, actually, the console is not crying. It is logging at the error level. Which is crying.

pedant-dfea8924.text: Well, actually, a random number is also data. Technically.

vc-00abaa32.text: I love it. Every chart goes up and to the right. Is this real data?

vc-0c9f9090.text: I'm going to be honest with you. I don't get it. Here is a check.

vc-10dccfc8.text: The ten year old is right. That is our entire go to market strategy.

vc-20ac0498.text: I have a quick question. Block out your afternoon.

vc-22141dfa.text: I wrote a roadmap. It's a Gantt chart. It's also a ransom note.

vc-32f47fa9.text: Quick sync? It'll take thirty minutes. It'll take ninety.

vc-39b3dfa3.text: A hundred thousand upvotes and zero working buttons. In my world, that is called traction.

vc-45739320.text: Let's put a pin in it. I have so many pins. The roadmap is a hedgehog.

vc-4b8ac6a6.text: Let's circle back on that. After we align on the alignment.

vc-5812b167.text: We are not a button company. We are a button platform.

vc-6b5914fe.text: Let us circle back and align on the alignment. I will send a calendar invite.

vc-77fca0b8.text: I love the energy. I love the deck. I do not love the numbers. Do you have other numbers?

vc-79510e7b.text: A weekend? Then it has no moat.

vc-7f7ea5ed.text: An infinite loop. Infinite growth. Finally, a metric I understand.

vc-82078599.text: Is it live yet? I need something for the board. Anything. A screenshot of a spinner.

vc-9368054c.text: I would like to buy it. Name a number. Any number. Say it softly.

vc-9d88fcc1.text: Product market fit. I can smell it. It smells like money. And ramen.

vc-a92b4ffc.text: Quick sync? I only need fifteen minutes. I will take forty.

vc-af7f4461.text: I love it. What's your moat?

vc-b5349dd6.text: We love your team. We love your vision. We love your pre-revenue. We will take it from here.

vc-bb7b378f.text: We usually write the check before the demo. The demo is just for morale.

vc-bc0b70e9.text: So, it's a wrapper. But it's a wrapper with, how shall I say, energy.

vc-c8b5dbdf.text: Is there a version of this deck with fewer words and more ARR?

vc-ccb64301.text: Thanks for coming in. Let me look at your numbers. Mm. Mm-hm. Fascinating. I am not reading them.

vc-ce5449af.text: Tell me about your traction. No, not the app. The vibes. How many vibes per month?

vc-db8c42ba.text: So it's a to-do list, but with a pitch deck. I'm in.

vc-ee32ab7b.text: We'd love to invest. Unfortunately, we only invest in companies that don't need our money.

wholesome-0ba08a20.text: I love it. It's cruelty free. Did I mention I'm vegan? I'm vegan.

wholesome-1020ae09.text: I made cookies for everyone! Except the build server. It knows why.

wholesome-1603e686.text: The vibes! I can feel them through the screen! I am being emotionally supported by a website!

wholesome-167796dc.text: Welcome! There are snacks in the kitchen! Please take your hood off, friend.

wholesome-1a0e9482.text: Aww. Give it a hug. It is meeting you for the first time. Again.

wholesome-1f51f98e.text: Be nice! Tax forms try their best.

wholesome-24468984.text: That is good enough for me! Upvoted!

wholesome-3c44adb6.text: Hi, friend! I love your product. I love you. How can I help?

wholesome-41a77732.text: It does everything, and it never crashes. Are you hiring? Can I just watch?

wholesome-44c7a86b.text: Sending positive thoughts, and also a small coupon.

wholesome-56e14fb3.text: Be nice. Everyone's vibe is valid.

wholesome-5aa762d7.text: I hope you're okay, friend. If you need to talk, I'm here. Not about the app. About the savings.

wholesome-5b80d193.text: I'll answer every comment with love. Even the mean ones. Especially the mean ones.

wholesome-5d549914.text: My dog typed into the terminal. A row of random letters. It compiled. He is a better developer than me.

wholesome-67c906d3.text: My kid downloaded your game. Now he speaks in levels. Level one: breakfast.

wholesome-681d7fe3.text: I don't know what this does, but I love it, and I love you.

wholesome-6f92dce3.text: It reminded me to call my mom. I had not in a year. We both cried.

wholesome-743c9dcc.text: Congrats on the launch! I think I'm the only one who saw it! I feel like I found a secret!

wholesome-7e13d84c.text: My cat ignored the app. Then he walked across the keyboard and bought the premium plan.

wholesome-7e162500.text: Everyone starts with hello world. Look how far you've come. I'm so proud of you.

wholesome-8596b70d.text: This is so cool! You made my day. Keep building, friend.

wholesome-8c5ff5b8.text: I joined! There are four of us now! Wait. Who are the other three?

wholesome-94245725.text: I made my cat a to-do list. He completed nothing. He is thriving.

wholesome-965cf3f2.text: This is amazing! Edit: thanks for the gold, kind stranger! Edit two: my inbox is on fire!

wholesome-a719a0ee.text: The little animation on the button! You can tell somebody really cared.

wholesome-a8fefab1.text: My dog loves this app. He has no thumbs, so he sneezed on the screen. It worked.

wholesome-ada28bb0.text: Quick reminder: you're all doing great, and the production site is down!

wholesome-b44969ea.text: I deleted my first comment because it wasn't kind enough. Here's a better one. You're doing great.

wholesome-bfff9d6a.text: I am a teacher. I paid for this with my own money. Like everything in my classroom.

wholesome-c7671302.text: Is the intern okay? I heard they pushed to main. Please check on the intern.

wholesome-d037face.text: I stared at it for ten minutes. I feel so calm. Is this a meditation app?

wholesome-d15ae4c6.text: Sending you so much love. You are so brave for sharing this.

wholesome-d4e0b683.text: A 2014 laptop built this? That is the most heartwarming thing I have seen all year.

wholesome-d5359aae.text: I won't say anything. I'm just here quietly. Not breathing.

wholesome-d82e494b.text: I downloaded it at three in the morning. It gave me ten quiet minutes. I am crying.

wholesome-e049f5b3.text: Your bug is not a failure. It's a surprise feature. I believe in you.

wholesome-e19aa9f9.text: This is awesome! Great job! Keep building! I believe in you!

wholesome-e5e0626a.text: Give the cat a treat! He is the only one here who has been honest!

wholesome-e7ca7155.text: I am so happy for you! What are the apps called?

wholesome-e945f7fc.text: Aww. Congratulations to the little spinners! Is there a home page for them?

wholesome-e9d12c1f.text: This is exactly what we needed! Where has this been all my life?

wholesome-fbd48e0b.text: Be nice! It tried its best! Look, it has a button!
